newsitem.title: USA: Tipperary to take Q4 charge on stock deal.
newsitem.headline: Tipperary to take Q4 charge on stock deal.

text.p: Tipperary Corp said Thursday it will record a non-cash charge of about $300,000 in the fourth quarter ended September 30 as part of its exchange of convertible preferred shares of U.S. Exploration Inc.
Tipperary exchanged 354,000 preferred shares for $796,000 cash and 150,000 shares of U.S. Exploration common.
Tipperary said it applied $320,000 of the proceeds toward the reduction of long-term bank debt.
The 150,000 shares of U.S. Exploration common carry demand registration rights. Tipperary said it has agreed not to sell into the public market before June 2, 1997.

In connection with the exchange, Tipperary and U.S. Exploration reached an agreement for payment of about $190,000 of dividends which had accrued on the preferred stock prior to the exchange, Tipperary said.
